parts.text:
You are a hydrogeologist preparing site notes for a borehole drilling team.

Station Odufor (Etche LGA survey stations). Interpreted VES layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 20.32 | 0.13606 | 0.13606
2 | 851.16 | 1.1039 | 1.2399
3 | 2511.9 | 15.803 | 17.043
4 | 1345 | - | -

The survey interpretation on file classifies this sounding curve as A-type.

Write the site note using exactly this template:

Station: <station name>
Curve type: <VES curve type>
Aquifer depth: <depth range in m>
Recommendation: <one or two sentences for the drilling team>

Station: Odufor
Curve type: A-type
Aquifer depth: 1.24 m – 17.04 m (resistive layer 3, 2511.9 ohm-m)
Recommendation: Case off the shallow, low-resistivity overburden (0–1.24 m) to prevent borehole collapse and screen the thick, highly resistive zone between ~1.24 m and 17.0 m, which represents the main aquifer; drill to a target depth of about 20 m to confirm the top of the underlying layer and ensure adequate water column and yield.
